//: THE SENATE AS A PLACE OF ACTION (GDD §6.1; GAP §10 item 2). These read SenateSystem's flags: motion_against_me (a censure or embargo of yours is on the docket), censured / recognised / levied / embargoed (a motion that touched you carried), motion_passed_mine / motion_failed_mine (your own motion was decided), act_open / act_passed (an Act of the Senate — a law for the whole Reach — is on the docket, or has carried), petition_open / petition_carried / petition_refused (an estate hostile across the Reach has brought its own Act, and the chamber's answer). They make the chamber personal: a whip at your door with coin, a censure to answer, a levy to pay or refuse.

effects.text: {self.name} took {whip.name}'s purse and promised a vote. Six credits, a friend in the chamber, and a story the benches will tell.
{self.name} wanted no coin from {whip.name} — a favour, to be named later. The whip agreed; whips always do.
{self.name} showed {whip.name} the door with the purse still in their hand. The vote stays the house's own.
{self.name} answered the motion from the floor, and the chamber went quiet to hear it. Whatever the vote, the Reach heard the house speak.
{self.name} spent the night calling in favours. Three houses that owed the house something remembered it before the vote.
{self.name} let the motion stand unanswered. Contempt is also an argument.
{self.name} bowed to the Senate's censure and said the words. The chamber likes a house that knows how to lose.
{self.name} tore the censure in half on the floor of the Senate. Half the chamber was appalled. The other half took notes.
{self.name} said nothing, and wrote down every house that voted for it.
{self.name} gave a feast for the houses that voted the recognition. Six credits, and a Senate that remembers the wine.
{self.name} accepted the recognition with a nod and went back to work. Standing is a thing you spend later.
{self.name} paid the Senate's levy and let the chair see it paid. A good subject, this season.
{self.name} paid, and spoke for an hour about the paying. The chamber remembered the speech longer than the coin.
{self.name} passed the levy down to the worlds as a tithe. The coin came back; the loyalty did not.
{self.name} spent the evening with the estates' men, asking what the Act would cost whom. By the vote {self.name} knew the chamber better than the clerk did.
{self.name} let the Act run its course. A house that leaves the Reach's law to the Reach is thought steady, if not ambitious.
{self.name} had the Act read in every square of the house's worlds, seal first. The magistrates approved of a lord who read the law aloud.
{self.name} received the Act and filed it where Acts go. The old blood noticed, and liked it; the clerk noticed too.
{self.name} received the petitioners' delegation in the hall and heard them out. Whatever the Senate does, the house's own squares were quieter for it.
{self.name} sent the delegation away unseen. The old blood approved; the squares did not.
{self.name} paid the petitioners' lodging at the capital for the session. The chamber noticed whose coin kept them fed; so did the estate.
{self.name} had the Senate's answer read in every square with the house's seal beside it, as if the house had moved it. Some believed that.
The Senate heard the petition; {self.name} let the clerks announce it and said nothing. The old blood took the silence as a sign of sense.
The Senate turned the petition away and {self.name} put the guard in the squares before the news did. Four credits of overtime; no fires.
{self.name} stood on the steps and blamed the Senate by name for the petition's refusal. The crowd went home; the chamber did not forget the speech.
{self.name} let the squares have their night. The old blood called it firmness. The watch called it a long shift.
{self.name}'s motion carried, and {self.name} spent the evening making sure every house knew whose it had been.
{self.name}'s motion carried. {self.name} thanked the houses that opposed it for the quality of their opposition.
